data.title: Book a Free College Project Consultation
data.description: Planning your final year project? Before you spend days building the wrong thing, let's discuss your idea. I help BCA, MCA, Diploma, and Engineering students choose the right technology, define project scope, estimate timelines, and build projects they can confidently explain during their viva.

data.text: 💬 A 15–30 minute discussion can save you weeks of unnecessary work.

data.title: Why Book a Consultation?
data.description: Many students start coding immediately without planning. They later discover missing features, database issues, or technologies that don't match their college requirements. A short consultation helps avoid these common mistakes.

data.caption: Good planning is the foundation of every successful project.

data.title: What We Can Help You Build
data.description: Whether you're starting from scratch or improving an existing project, we can help with modern technologies and real-world architectures.

data.text: Every project is planned around your syllabus, deadline, and budget—not with a one-size-fits-all approach.

data.title: Already Started Your Project?
data.description: You don't need to begin again. If you're facing errors, incomplete features, deployment issues, or database problems, we can review your existing work and recommend the best next steps.

data.title: What's Included If You Work With Me?
data.description: The goal isn't simply to deliver code. It's to help you submit a project you understand and can confidently present.

data.title: Student-Friendly Pricing
data.description: Every project is different, so pricing depends on your requirements, deadline, and complexity. During the consultation, you'll receive a clear estimate before any work begins.

data.text: No hidden charges. No unnecessary upselling. Just practical advice and transparent pricing.

data.title: Free Resources for Students
data.description: Looking for notes, semester PDFs, and study resources? Pixel Class helps students organize learning materials, discover classmates, and access academic resources from one platform.

data.title: Ready to Discuss Your Project?
data.description: Share your project idea, preferred technology, deadline, and college requirements. Whether you need complete development, debugging, documentation, or deployment help, we'll find the best solution together.

data.question: Is the consultation free?
data.answer: Yes. The initial discussion is free. We'll understand your requirements, recommend a suitable approach, and explain the available options before any work begins.

data.question: Can you help with an existing project?
data.answer: Yes. If you've already started your project, I can help fix bugs, add features, improve the architecture, assist with deployment, or explain the implementation.

data.question: Do you only work with React projects?
data.answer: No. Support is available for React, MERN Stack, Next.js, Python, Django, Java, PHP, React Native, AI projects, and other academic software projects.

data.question: Will I understand the project after it's completed?
data.answer: That's the goal. Along with development, you'll receive guidance so you can explain the project's architecture, features, and implementation during your viva or presentation.
